Generic cache/valkey browser: a lazy prefix tree with server-side key search on the left, and on the right either the whole-keyspace stats overview (nothing selected), an aggregated subtree overview (prefix selected) or full key detail with adapter-pluggable value rendering (key selected). Requires a react-query QueryClientProvider in the host app, like TimeseriesPanel.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/cache-browser/CacheBrowser.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CacheBrowser } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
